description: This file defines the SaveEmployeeReportController class responsible for managing the preparation of data and components for the employee report save/edit interface within the OrangeHRM system. It handles fetching report filter fields, display field groups, and display fields, and sets up a Vue component with these properties.

classes.name: SaveEmployeeReportController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for preparing the Vue component for saving or editing employee reports, including setting report filters and display options.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component with report filter criteria, display field groups, and fields, based on the request parameters. It configures the component for rendering report save/edit interface.
